text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
During the break, I visited the "Space Museum."
To Neo Universe, it's
another—"Mother Planet."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Here's a "souvenir."
Give this space food a try.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, guess what flavor it is...
without looking at the label. It's 'fun'.

Spending time at her favorite spot,
Neo Universe seems to have gotten some good rest!
